purpose: Repeat the exact frozen v1 rule with a collector designed to avoid multi-hour GitHub cron gaps.

collection.primaryContinuation: workflow_dispatch self-chain after each persisted batch
collection.watchdog: hourly bounded-date watchdog dispatches only when persisted receipt is stale by at least 10 minutes
collection.activation: First persisted main-branch repeat2 batch; expiresAt remains startedAt + 72 hours and cannot restart or extend.

limitations: Coverage is measured, not guaranteed; GitHub runner or platform outages can still create gaps.
The watchdog is recovery-only and does not modify the frozen signal rule.
The NO-KV response contract demonstrates the shadow route bypasses RADAR_HISTORY in the Worker code path; Cloudflare billing counters are not independently read here.
Conditional returns are models, not realized profit, HIT or MISS.
